pages.title: Hypernova Alloy Ingot
pages.text: Cosmic neutronium, spacetime alloy, glueballs, hyperons and a superheavy metal, all melted together above the temperature at which matter can still be said to have a melting point. The ingot never cools. Its glow is the afterimage of a collapsing star that the metal seems to remember, and it is warm through any glove.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Transcendent Plasma Forge finally ran hot enough that the ingredients stopped behaving as separate materials. I dropped in a supernova remnant to seed the melt and an alloy of everything I had came out, still shining long after the forge shut down.

Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Stellar Transcendence.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Eye of the Event Horizon, Hypernova Plasma, Omnium Ingot, Transcendent Metal Ingot, Transcendent Plasma, Transfinite Coil Block, Unified Notes I.
